title.zh: 参数窗口：一个旋钮牵动多项指标
title.en: Parameter windows: one knob affects many metrics

subtitle.zh: 速率、形貌、选择比与均匀性。

body.zh: 核心判断；工艺窗口要让多个指标同时达标；只追求更高刻蚀速率，；可能缩小其他指标的余量。
body.en: Core assessment The process window must meet multiple metrics simultaneously; pursuing only a higher etch rate can reduce margins for other metrics

body.zh: 流程位置；在路线确定后，建立配方窗口与日常监控条件。
body.en: Position in the flow After selecting the route, establish the recipe window and routine monitoring conditions

body.zh: 调参流程；1 定义验收；规格
2；建立基准；条件
3 设计受控试验
输出指标；和窗口边界
化学与供给；干法气体组成；；湿法药液组成、；浓度及浴液状态。
body.en: Chemistry and supply Dry-etch gas composition; wet-bath composition, concentration and bath condition

body.zh: 能量与温度；干法源功率、基片；偏压和温控；；湿法液温。
body.en: Energy and temperature Dry source power, wafer bias and temperature control; wet-bath temperature

body.zh: 输运条件；干法腔压与流量；；湿法流动、润湿；及装载。
body.en: Transport conditions Dry chamber pressure and flow; wet flow, wetting and loading

body.zh: 时间与停止；主刻蚀时间、；终点判据和；过刻安排。
body.en: Time and stopping Main-etch time, endpoint criteria and overetch plan

body.zh: 输出指标（同时达标的窗口）；速率；（刻蚀速率）
body.en: Output metrics (simultaneously acceptable window) Rate (etch rate)

body.zh: 形貌；（侧壁/底部）
选择比；（目标层/保护层）
均匀性；（片内分布）
共同；合格窗口
量测反馈；建立速率、形貌、选择比；及片内分布的联合结果表，；找同时满足规格的条件；范围。；反馈优化
body.en: Metrology feedback Build a combined results table for rate, profile, selectivity and within-wafer distribution, then find conditions meeting all specifications simultaneously Feedback optimization

body.zh: 耦合与失效；提高基片偏压可能改善部分底部去除，也可能增加；损伤和掩膜损耗；湿法温度或药液状态改变，目标层；与保护层速率未必同比变化。；异常可表现为尺寸漂移、残留和片内不均。
body.en: Coupling and failure Higher wafer bias may improve some bottom removal but may also increase damage and mask loss; changes in wet-bath temperature or state may not change target-layer and protective-layer rates proportionally Anomalies may appear as dimensional drift, residue or within-wafer nonuniformity

body.zh: 尺寸漂移；残留；片内不均
下游影响与边界；窗口偏窄会使上游膜厚、图形密度变化更容易传到下游。；在典型ICP-RIE中，源功率主要影响等离子体产生，偏压主要调节离子能量；；实际仍存在耦合，不能给出万能单调规律。
body.en: Downstream effects and boundaries A narrow window makes upstream film-thickness and pattern-density variation propagate downstream more easily In typical ICP-RIE, source power mainly affects plasma generation while bias mainly controls ion energy; coupling remains, so no universal monotonic rule applies

body.zh: 上游变化；工艺窗口；下游影响
body.en: Upstream variation Process window Downstream effects
